dossier.scp_unleashed.073.title: Cain
dossier.scp_unleashed.073.caption: SCP-073 as first sighted, walking alone across open sand.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-073 is cooperative and is to be housed in a dry humanoid cell with a sand floor. He may walk the cell freely. No plants, cut flowers or other greenery are to be brought into the cell.

Staff may speak with SCP-073 at any time. **No member of staff is to strike SCP-073, restrain him by force or otherwise try to injure him.** Anyone who acts aggressively toward him is to be removed from the assignment at once.
SCP-073 is not to be moved across open water.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-073 is a man of average height and calm manner, with a warm olive complexion, dark hair worn long and rough, and a short dark beard. He wears plain white robes and calls himself Cain. Both of his arms are prosthetics of brushed steel, jointed at the elbow and wrist, with finely segmented fingers. He has never said who made them.

SCP-073 does not attack, and he has never shown hostility to anyone. He walks a great deal, slowly and with no clear destination, and he will stop to watch anyone who comes close. He answers questions politely and briefly.
Living plants do not thrive near SCP-073. Foliage close to him dries out and falls away, and grass does not survive where he walks. %rThe cause is not known.%r
SCP-073 avoids water and will not enter it by choice.
No attempt to injure SCP-073 has ever succeeded. Staff are advised not to make another.

page.title: Addendum 073-1: Recovery
text: SCP-073 was first encountered walking alone across open desert, far from any road or settlement. He came with the recovery team without complaint and asked only that he be allowed to keep walking.
He has since been found only in desert country, and only after this file has been opened.

page.title: Addendum 073-2: Interview Note
text: Asked about his arms, SCP-073 said he had grown used to them. Asked about the plants, he said: "Nothing green stays near me. I stopped minding a long time ago."
Asked what happened to the guard who struck him on the day of his recovery, he did not answer. %rThe guard was carried out.%r

message.scp_unleashed.scp073.refuses: The controller finds nothing in SCP-073 to take hold of
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.0: The sand keeps no footprints for long. I find that restful.
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.1: Walk with me, if you like. I do not stop often.
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.2: Nothing green stays near me. I stopped minding long ago.
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.3: I would rather you kept your hands at your sides.
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.4: Water and I do not agree. I keep to the dry places.
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.5: I remember a great many things. Few are worth repeating.
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.6: The wind out here sounds the same as it always has.
message.scp_unleashed.scp073.line.7: You look tired. Sit a while, if you can find the shade.
SCP-073, "Cain": a calm man in long white robes whose arms are steel prosthetics. He is Safe-class and never attacks anyone.
He does not occur naturally. Once his archive file has been read, he may be found wandering alone in desert country.
Leaves and grass do not last long around him, and he keeps well away from water.
